It pairs the 2.5 liter four cylinder with the Lineartronic CVT and Subaru all wheel drive, so Chicago winters are a non issue. Inside there is leather seating, heated front seats, dual power seats, a navigation system, harman/kardon audio, SUBARU STARLINK with Bluetooth and SiriusXM, push button start, and a moon roof. Driver assistance is the real strength: EyeSight, adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, blind spot detection, and a backup camera, backed by knee air bags and full length head curtain air bags. LED headlamps, fog lights, alloy wheels, and the All Weather Package round it out. Finished in silver over a black interior.
